points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 穆罕默德·阿里·真纳于1876年12月25日出生于卡拉奇的一个信德商人家庭。他的父亲是来自古吉拉特邦的商人，家庭属于什叶派穆斯林。真纳在卡拉奇接受早期教育，展现出非凡的才智和勤奋。1887年，他进入卡拉奇基督教学校学习，后转入信德穆斯林学校。1892年，他16岁时前往英国伦敦学习法律，这标志着他人生的重要转折点。
points.descriptionEn: Muhammad Ali Jinnah was born on December 25, 1876, in Karachi to a prosperous merchant family of Gujarati Khoja Shia Muslims. He received his early education in Karachi, showing exceptional intelligence and diligence. In 1887, he entered the Christian Missionary Society School and later transferred to the Sind Madrasatul Islam. At the age of 16, in 1892, he traveled to London to study law, marking a pivotal turning point in his life.

points.title: 法律学习
points.description: 在伦敦林肯律师学院，真纳展现出卓越的法律才能。1896年，他成为英国最年轻的律师之一。在此期间，他深受英国政治制度影响，同时开始关注印度事务。他加入了印度协会，并撰写文章讨论印度在英国议会中的代表权问题。这段经历塑造了他的政治理念，使他认识到法律和政治在争取民族权利中的重要性。
points.descriptionEn: At Lincoln's Inn in London, Jinnah demonstrated exceptional legal talent. In 1896, he became one of the youngest barristers in Britain. During this period, he was deeply influenced by the British political system while beginning to focus on Indian affairs. He joined the India Society and wrote articles about Indian representation in the British Parliament. This experience shaped his political philosophy, making him recognize the importance of law and politics in securing national rights.

points.title: 律师生涯
points.description: 返回印度后，真纳在孟买开始了成功的律师生涯，迅速成为印度最著名的律师之一。他以清晰的逻辑和雄辩的口才著称，处理了许多复杂的商业案件。1906年，他加入印度国民大会党，但最初保持温和立场。1910年，他获选为印度立法会议成员，成为印度穆斯林在政治舞台上的重要代表。这一时期，他致力于促进印度教徒和穆斯林之间的合作，认为联合行动是争取印度自治的关键。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to India, Jinnah began a successful legal career in Bombay, rapidly becoming one of India's most prominent barristers. He was known for his clear logic and eloquent arguments, handling many complex commercial cases. In 1906, he joined the Indian National Congress but initially maintained a moderate stance. In 1910, he was elected to the Imperial Legislative Council, becoming an important representative of Indian Muslims in the political arena. During this period, he worked to promote cooperation between Hindus and Muslims, believing that united action was key to achieving Indian self-governance.

points.title: 政治转型
points.description: 1913年，真纳加入全印穆斯林联盟，标志着他从国大党温和派向穆斯林权益代言人的转变。他提出'印度教-穆斯林团结'的理念，试图调和两大宗教群体的矛盾。1916年，他促成国大党与穆斯林联盟的勒克瑙协议，确立了双方在立法机构中的代表比例。然而，随着印度民族运动的发展，特别是1919年《罗拉特法》和1920年非暴力不合作运动的兴起，真纳逐渐与甘地的激进策略产生分歧。他主张通过宪政途径而非群众运动实现印度自治，这一立场使他与国大党的关系日益紧张。
points.descriptionEn: In 1913, Jinnah joined the All-India Muslim League, marking his transformation from a Congress moderate to an advocate for Muslim rights. He proposed the idea of 'Hindu-Muslim unity,' attempting to reconcile the two religious communities. In 1916, he facilitated the Lucknow Pact between the Congress and the Muslim League, establishing their respective representation in legislative bodies. However, as the Indian nationalist movement evolved, particularly with the Rowlatt Act of 1919 and the rise of Gandhi's non-cooperation movement in 1920, Jinnah increasingly disagreed with Gandhi's radical strategies. He advocated for constitutional methods rather than mass movements to achieve Indian self-governance, straining his relationship with the Congress.

points.title: 建国运动
points.description: 1930年代，真纳的政治立场发生根本转变，从印度统一支持者转向穆斯林独立建国倡导者。1940年，他在拉合尔会议上提出'巴基斯坦'构想，主张建立独立的穆斯林国家。面对英国的分而治之政策和印度教民族主义的兴起，真纳坚持穆斯林必须拥有独立的政治实体。他运用法律和政治技巧，在复杂的谈判中为穆斯林争取最大利益。1946年，他拒绝内阁派遣计划，坚持穆斯林联盟必须拥有独立政府。1947年6月，英国通过《蒙巴顿方案》，同意印巴分治。真纳作为巴基斯坦首任总督，领导了建国初期的艰难过渡。
points.descriptionEn: During the 1930s, Jinnah underwent a fundamental political transformation, shifting from supporting Indian unity to advocating for an independent Muslim state. In 1940, he proposed the 'Pakistan' idea at the Lahore Conference, calling for the establishment of a separate Muslim nation. Facing British divide-and-rule policies and the rise of Hindu nationalism, Jinnah insisted that Muslims must have an independent political entity. He employed legal and political skills to secure maximum benefits for Muslims in complex negotiations. In 1946, he rejected the Cabinet Mission Plan, insisting the Muslim League must have its own government. In June 1947, Britain approved the Mountbatten Plan, agreeing to the partition of India. As Pakistan's first governor-general, Jinnah led the difficult transition of the new nation.

points.title: 建国奠基
points.description: 1947年8月14日，巴基斯坦正式成立，真纳成为首任总督。他面临巨大挑战：处理大规模难民潮、建立国家机构、制定宪法框架、稳定经济。1948年1月，他发表了著名的'团结、信仰、纪律'演讲，为年轻国家指明方向。尽管健康状况恶化，他仍坚持工作，试图在巴基斯坦建立民主、世俗的国家。1948年9月11日，真纳在卡拉奇逝世，年仅71岁。他的去世使巴基斯坦失去了一位强有力的领导人，但他的建国理念和对穆斯林民族身份的坚持，继续影响着巴基斯坦的政治发展。
points.descriptionEn: On August 14, 1947, Pakistan was formally established, and Jinnah became its first governor-general. He faced enormous challenges: handling massive refugee movements, establishing state institutions, formulating constitutional frameworks, and stabilizing the economy. In January 1948, he delivered his famous 'Unity, Faith, Discipline' speech, providing direction for the young nation. Despite deteriorating health, he continued working to establish a democratic, secular state in Pakistan. On September 11, 1948, Jinnah died in Karachi at the age of 71. His death left Pakistan without a strong leader, but his vision of statehood and his insistence on Muslim national identity continue to influence Pakistan's political development.

supporter.zh: 真纳被誉为'巴基斯坦国父'，是一位杰出的政治家和战略家。支持者认为他通过坚定的领导力和政治远见，为南亚穆斯林赢得了独立国家。他坚持穆斯林民族自决权，在复杂的政治环境中为巴基斯坦的建立奠定了基础。真纳强调的'团结、信仰、纪律'理念成为巴基斯坦的国家核心价值观。他倡导的世俗民主理念，尽管在后来的发展中有所偏离，但体现了他对现代国家建设的深刻理解。
supporter.en: Jinnah is revered as the 'Father of the Nation' in Pakistan, celebrated as an exceptional statesman and strategist. Supporters credit him with securing an independent nation for South Asian Muslims through firm leadership and political foresight. His insistence on Muslim self-determination laid the foundation for Pakistan's establishment amidst complex political circumstances. The principles of 'Unity, Faith, Discipline' that he emphasized became core national values. His advocacy for secular democracy, though later somewhat偏离, demonstrated his profound understanding of modern state-building.

critic.zh: 批评者认为真纳的建国理念导致了印度次大陆的分裂和大规模暴力冲突。他们指出，真纳在后期政治立场的转变过于激进，放弃了早期印度教-穆斯林团结的理想。批评者还质疑他建立巴基斯坦的动机，认为可能是个人权力欲望而非纯粹的宗教或民族考量。此外，真纳对巴基斯坦内部复杂的民族、教派问题考虑不足，导致巴基斯坦建国后面临持续的内部冲突和治理挑战。他的威权领导风格也被认为不利于民主制度的建立。
critic.en: Critics argue that Jinnah's vision of statehood led to the partition of the Indian subcontinent and massive communal violence. They contend his later political shift was too radical, abandoning his earlier ideal of Hindu-Muslim unity. Critics also question his motives for creating Pakistan, suggesting personal power ambitions rather than purely religious or nationalist considerations. Additionally, Jinnah failed to adequately address Pakistan's complex internal ethnic and sectarian issues, leading to persistent internal conflicts and governance challenges after independence. His authoritarian leadership style is also seen as detrimental to democratic institution-building.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为真纳是一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是成功的律师，又是坚定的政治家；既是印度统一的支持者，又是巴基斯坦的缔造者。在流行文化中，真纳常被描绘为严肃、威严的领导者形象，被称为'伟大领袖'。历史学者评价他是一位务实主义政治家，善于运用法律和政治技巧实现目标。他的建国决策反映了20世纪民族主义思潮和宗教政治化的复杂历史背景。尽管巴基斯坦建国后的发展轨迹与他最初的设想有所不同，但真纳作为现代巴基斯坦国家象征的地位无可争议。
objective.en: Historians generally view Jinnah as a complex and contradictory figure. He was both a successful lawyer and a determined statesman; both an advocate for Indian unity and the creator of Pakistan. In popular culture, Jinnah is often depicted as a stern, authoritative leader figure, known as the 'Great Leader.' Academic historians evaluate him as a pragmatic politician skilled in using legal and political tactics to achieve his goals. His statehood decision reflects the complex historical context of 20th-century nationalism and the politicization of religion. Although Pakistan's subsequent development trajectory differed from his initial vision, Jinnah's status as a symbol of modern Pakistani nationhood is undisputed.

self.zh: 你们要记住，你们是一个国家，你们有自己的文化传统、生活习俗和文学历史。你们有自己的历史英雄和传统。
self.en: You must remember that you are a nation, you have your own culture, traditions, and history. You have your own heroes and your own traditions.

others.zh: 真纳是印度历史上最伟大的律师之一，他拥有非凡的政治才能和坚定的决心。他是一位真正的国家缔造者，他的智慧和远见将继续指引巴基斯坦的未来。
others.en: Jinnah was one of the greatest lawyers in Indian history, possessing extraordinary political talent and unwavering determination. He was a true nation-builder, and his wisdom and foresight will continue to guide Pakistan's future.
